company.name: UtilityScore
company.shortDescription: UtilityScore provides personalized recommendations for home improvements that save 25% on energy and water bills.
company.description: UtilityScore provides a tool that covers all utilities including electricity, natural gas, water, sewer, and a national database of local utility rates. The company provides personalized recommendations for home efficiency and solar, using its users home address. It helps house hunters understand their costs before buying or renting. UtilityScore was founded by Brian Gitt in 2015 and is based in Oakland, California.
